findings.title: Strawberry coercion-error log echoes submitted values
findings.detail: A hand-crafted anonymous registerNetworkInterest request with a wrongly typed variable (e.g. phone as int) or inline literal values is rejected by GraphQL coercion/validation, and Strawberry's default process_errors logs the message including the invalid value (and, for inline literals, the source line with the name). Spot-checked against the installed api-venv Strawberry/graphql-core. The shipped web form uses typed variables and cannot trigger it.
findings.fix: Override Schema.process_errors (or filter the strawberry.execution logger) to log value-free lines for validation/coercion errors, at least for registerNetworkInterest; add a caplog test with an int phone and an inline-literal document asserting the digits and name are absent. Close before production per AC 18.

findings.title: Global hourly ceiling is the only abuse control
findings.detail: A script can fill the 200/hour cap with junk new contacts and lock out real registrations; accepted by Reddy for v1 (D2/D3/D7, D8).
findings.fix: Treat the network.interest_ceiling WARNING as an alarm candidate; revisit per-IP/WAF limits if it fires.

findings.title: D4 consent wording is still a draft
findings.detail: CONSENT_VERSION 2026-10-03 and the en/te privacy text are flagged DRAFT in network.py, landingContent.ts, PrivacyPage.tsx and docs/specs/TODO-pattadar-network.md.
findings.fix: Obtain Reddy's explicit approval of the wording before any production release.
